Thanks for the warm intro — Microsoft submitted a Partner Center referral for GreenSky Analytics last night (PC-REF-89012). We're evaluating a POC for inference latency-sensitive features and would like to align on seller ownership and the co-sell cadence before the MS seller reaches out.

Couple quick asks:
- Confirm who from Redwood will own outbound engagement to the GreenSky decision team (we'd prefer a single point of contact).
- Are there any existing account mappings in Partner Center that could cause duplicate outreach?
- Can we get a short mutual action plan so we can coordinate internal stakeholders on our side?

I'm copying the Partner Center referral mailbox for visibility.

GreenSky Analytics

Laura / Emma — I pulled Partner Center and internal CRM. Notes:
- PC shows an owner 'Redwood Solutions Team' (generic) but no single named seller.
- CRM has a stale contact (j.santos@greensky) from 2024; appears to be unverified.
- There are two orphaned accounts that may match GreenSky by domain (greenskyanalytics.com) — potential duplicate outreach risk.

Recommendation:
1) Assign a named AE to the referral in Partner Center now to prevent automatic MS outreach to the generic owner.
2) Perform a lightweight account grooming step: confirm primary GreenSky contact and collapse orphaned records. I can run the grooming if you authorize.

Attachment: pc-ownership-screenshot.png (image stub)

If you want, I can assign the AE as 'karthik_iyer' for now and swap to a rep after confirmation.

-Vanessa
